updates.description: WHEN: Any phase. TARGET: One ADEPTA SORORITAS CHARACTER model from your army that was just destroyed. You can use this stratagem on that model even though it was just destroyed. EFFECT: You can discard 1-3 Miracle dice. At the end of the phase, set up that model on the battlefield, unengaged and as close as possible to where it was destroyed. That model is not part of an Attached unit and its unit has a Starting Strength of 1. Roll one D3, adding 1 to the result for each Miracle die you discarded. That model has that number of wounds remaining, up to its starting number of wounds. RESTRICTION: You cannot select SAINT CELESTINE as the target of this stratagem. You cannot select the same CHARACTER model as the target of this stratagem more than once per battle.

updates.description: In your Movement phase, each time this unit is set up on the battlefield using the Deep Strike ability, it can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6" horizontally away from all Afflicted enemy units, and more than 8" horizontally away from all other enemy units.

updates.description: Just after an enemy unit ends a Normal, Advance or Fall Back move within 8" of a friendly DEATH GUARD unit that is within 6" of this model, if that DEATH GUARD unit is not within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, it can make a Normal move of up to 5".

updates.description: Each time a unit from your army is destroyed, if every model (excluding CHARACTER models) in that unit has this ability, you can spend the relevant number of Resurgence points based on that unit's Starting Strength (not including attached CHARACTER models). If you do, add a new unit to your army identical to that destroyed unit (excluding CHARACTER models), in Cult Ambush, at its Starting Strength, with all of its wounds remaining and any [ONE SHOT] weapons those models are equipped with considered as not having been shot, then place one Cult Ambush marker more than 8" horizontally away from all enemy units.

updates.description: Return one destroyed model (excluding CHARACTER models) to that unit and then, for every 2YP you just spent, return up to one additional destroyed model (excluding CHARACTER models) to that unit.

In your turn, when this unit makes an ingress/advance move using its Transdimensional Displacement ability, this unit can end that move more than 6 inches horizontally from all enemy units. When this unit ends that move within 8 inches of an enemy unit, this unit is not eligible to declare a charge until the end of the turn.

updates.description: In your Command phase, you can select up to 3 ADEPTA SORORITAS units from your army, including units embarked within TRANSPORTS. Until the start of your next Command phase, those units are Righteous. While a unit is Righteous: add 1" to the Move characteristic of models in that unit; improve the Leadership characteristic of models in that unit by 1; improve the Weapon Skill and Ballistic Skill characteristics of weapons equipped by BATTLE SISTERS SQUAD, CELESTIAN INSIDIANTS, CELESTIAN SACRESANTS and PARAGON WARSUITS models in that unit by 1.
updates.source: Faction Pack - Adepta Sororitas v1.2, page 1

updates.description: Friendly CELESTIAN units' attacks have +1 BS and +1 WS. This detachment has the REVEREND tag and cannot be taken with another REVEREND detachment.

updates.description: When mustering your army, you can include HARLEQUINS units in your army even though they do not have the ASURYANI keyword. The combined points cost of such units depends on your battle size. When mustering your army, you can select a friendly HARLEQUINS CHARACTER model to be your WARLORD.
updates.source: Faction Pack - Aeldari v1.3, pages 1 and 30
Faction Pack - Aeldari v1.3, page 31

updates.description: If your Army Faction is DEATH GUARD, while an enemy unit is within Contagion Range of one or more DEATH GUARD units from your army, it is Afflicted. During Declare Battle Formations, select one Plague. While an enemy unit is Afflicted, subtract 1 from its Toughness and apply the selected Plague. Skullsquirm Blight: each time a model in this unit makes a ranged attack, enemy units have the Benefit of Cover against that attack; each time a model in this unit makes a melee attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll. Rattlejoint Ague: worsen the Save characteristic of models in this unit by 1. Scabrous Soulrot: worsen the Move, Leadership and Objective Control characteristics of models in this unit by 1, to a minimum Objective Control of 1.
updates.source: Faction Pack - Death Guard v1.2, page 7

updates.description: WHEN: Start of your opponent's Charge phase. TARGET: One friendly unengaged DEATH GUARD VEHICLE unit. EFFECT: Select one visible enemy unit within 12" of your unit. When that enemy unit declares a charge, that enemy unit has -1 to Charge rolls.
updates.source: Faction Pack - Death Guard v1.2, page 7

updates.description: At the end of the Fight phase, if there are no models currently embarked within this TRANSPORT, you can select one friendly DRUKHARI INFANTRY unit that has 6 or fewer models and is wholly within 6" of this TRANSPORT; you cannot select a unit that can FLY. Unless that unit is within Engagement Range of one or more enemy units, it can embark within this TRANSPORT. That unit can embark within this TRANSPORT in a turn it disembarked from a TRANSPORT.
updates.source: Faction Pack - Drukhari v1.2, page 8

updates.description: WHEN: End of the Fight phase. TARGET: One friendly EMPEROR'S CHILDREN unit that is eligible to embark within a friendly TRANSPORT. EFFECT: Your unit can embark within that TRANSPORT. Your unit can embark within that TRANSPORT in a turn it disembarked from a TRANSPORT.
updates.source: Faction Pack - Emperor's Children v1.2, page 9

updates.description: WHEN: Your Movement phase. TARGET: One NECRONS unit from your army, excluding MONSTER units, that is arriving using an ingress move this phase. EFFECT: Your unit can be set up anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 6" horizontally away from all enemy models. RESTRICTION: A unit targeted with this stratagem is not eligible to declare a charge in the same turn.
updates.source: Faction Pack - Necrons v1.2, page 29

updates.description: In your Movement phase, excluding the first battle round, you can select one friendly NECRONS INFANTRY unit that is either in strategic reserves or on the battlefield. If you select a unit on the battlefield, remove that unit and place it into strategic reserves. That unit can make an ingress move, and while making that ingress move it must be set up wholly within 6" of this unit and unengaged, instead of more than 8" horizontally from all enemy units, even if that is within your opponent's deployment zone. That unit cannot make a charge move this turn.
updates.source: Faction Pack - Necrons v1.2, page 30

updates.description: WHEN: Any phase, just after an ORKS VEHICLE unit from your army with the Deadly Demise ability is destroyed. TARGET: That destroyed ORKS VEHICLE unit, if you roll a 6 for its Deadly Demise ability. You can use this stratagem on that unit even though it was just destroyed. EFFECT: Your unit can make a Normal or Fall Back move before its Deadly Demise ability is resolved and before any embarked units perform an emergency disembark move. When making this move, your unit can move over enemy units, excluding MONSTERS and VEHICLES, as if they were not there.
updates.source: Faction Pack - Orks v1.2, page 24

updates.description: In your Shooting phase, after this model has shot, select one enemy unit hit by one or more of those attacks made with a rivet kannon. Until the start of your next turn, that enemy unit is suppressed. While a unit is suppressed, each time a model in that unit makes a ranged attack, subtract 1 from the Hit roll.
updates.source: Faction Pack - Orks v1.2, page 26

updates.description: Each time an attack targets a BOYZ unit from your army, models in that unit have a 6+ invulnerable save against that attack. Each time an attack targets a BOYZ unit from your army that contains 10 or more models, models in that unit have a 5+ invulnerable save against that attack. When resolving an attacking unit's attacks, the number of models in the target unit when it was targeted determines that unit's invulnerable save until those attacks are resolved; do not change the save partway through those attacks as casualties are removed.
updates.source: Faction Pack - Orks v1.2, pages 26-27

updates.description: WHEN: Your Movement phase, just after an ORKS TRANSPORT unit from your army ends a Normal move. TARGET: That TRANSPORT unit. EFFECT: Units embarked within your TRANSPORT can make an assault disembark move as described in Core Rules 18.06.
updates.source: Faction Pack - Orks v1.2, page 24

updates.description: When a friendly GREY HUNTERS unit starts an action, that action does not prevent that unit from being eligible to shoot. During the Declare Battle Formations step, you can select one friendly GREY HUNTERS unit and split it into two units as evenly as possible. When splitting a unit in this way, record which models form each of the two new units. Your army can include SPACE WOLVES units, but it cannot include ADEPTUS ASTARTES units drawn from any other Chapter.
updates.source: Faction Pack - Space Wolves v1.2

updates.description: WHEN: Any phase, just before an ENDLESS MULTITUDE unit from your army that is within Synapse Range of your army makes a surge move. TARGET: That ENDLESS MULTITUDE unit. EFFECT: When making that surge move, you can re-roll the D6 to determine how far your unit moves, and your unit can end that move as close as possible to the closest objective marker instead of as close as possible to the closest enemy unit. All other rules for making surge moves still apply.
updates.source: https://wahapedia.ru/wh40k10ed/factions/tyranids/

updates.description: When this unit declares a charge, if an enemy MONSTER/VEHICLE unit is within 12" of this unit and was hit by an attack made by this weapon this turn, you can use this ability. If you do, this unit has +2 to Charge rolls until the end of the phase and this unit must end that charge move engaged with that MONSTER/VEHICLE unit.
updates.source: Faction Pack - Tyranids v1.2, page 20

updates.description: At the end of your Charge phase, if this unit is on the battlefield, is unengaged and contains a Bodyguard model, this unit makes a Leadership roll. If that Leadership roll is failed, one Bodyguard model in this unit is destroyed.
updates.source: Faction Pack - World Eaters v1.2, page 8
